name: Young Blood
notes: not_found: Youngblood is a reservation-only 16-seat speakeasy hidden inside Neighborhood bar at 777 G St, San Diego, offering a single fixed-price cocktail-flight experience (a welcome glass plus a curated 3-cocktail flight, no printed drink menu) confirmed at $65 per person by multiple independent sources (SDFoodies, theresandiego.com). Own site (www.youngbloodsucks.com, note bare domain without www fails DNS resolution) is a thin Squarespace splash page linking only to an OpenTable reservation widget, with zero per-item prices anywhere. No individual cocktails or dishes are priced; it is an all-inclusive experience price, matching the playbook's not-found category for an all-inclusive lounge.

name: Lobster Lab
notes: Lobster Lab has multiple San Diego-area locations, each with its own menu; the work-list address 890 Palomar Airport Rd is the Carlsbad Windmill Food Hall location, so this uses the site's 'food-halls' PDF (shared by the Windmill/Miramar/Global Fork food-hall locations), not the much larger Sky Deck at Del Mar PDF also linked from the same page, which is a different branch with a different menu (entrees, wine list, cocktails) and was NOT used. Captured Rolls, Sandwiches, Grilled Cheese, Salads, and Soups sections in full. One item, Lobster Salad, was omitted: the PDF's multi-column Salads table has scrambled header/value alignment under pdftotext (a 'LOBSTER' header with no price on its line, while an unlabeled $34 lines up under 'CRAB'), so its price could not be confidently paired and was dropped rather than guessed; Crab ($34), Shrimp ($20) and Smoked Salmon ($22) salad prices were on unambiguous same-line pairs and are included. All prices are whole dollars with no markup pattern.
